[[File:Mutukai_Adept_robe_render.png|thumb|250px|A style of Matukai Adept robes common during the [[Old Sith Wars]].]]
These '''[[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]]''' were worn by individuals who had mastered the [[Matukai/Legends|Matukai]] philosophy of achieving harmony between the mind and body, hence were capable of incredible physical feats. The Matukai were an order of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] who used exercise as a form of meditation. The balance of the physical body and spiritual [[The Force/Legends|Force]] was the cornerstone of their philosophy.
